items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of disability pension
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted 18.11.2026 (Wednesday); no separate Tag der Aufgabe zur Post is stated, so the printed date is the posting day. Posted after 1 Jan 2025, so delivery fiction = 4th calendar day after posting: 18.11 + 4 = 22.11.2026 (Sunday). The sender is a statutory pension insurance carrier (social-law body), not a tax office, so the delivery day does NOT shift off a weekend/holiday (unlike tax offices under section 108 Abs. 3 AO); delivery is deemed on Sunday 22.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period under section 84 SGG: the delivery day itself is not counted (section 187 Abs. 1 BGB analog via section 26 SGB X); the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same number (section 188 Abs. 2 BGB), i.e. 22.12.2026. That day is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under section 193 BGB is needed.
